name: Hatefury Horn
summary: A Hatefury Horn is taken from one of the satyrs in the Sargeron ruins east of Nijel’s Point. Kreldig Ungor gathers horns and claws for a reagent list from Kharanos.

sections.title: A Reagent from Sargeron
sections.body: East of Nijel’s Point, the Hatefury satyrs haunt the Sargeron ruins. Their horns are among the reagents Kreldig Ungor needs for Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos. Kreldig asks for ten horns alongside ten Hatefury claws, though he cannot promise their quality.

faq.q: Where do Hatefury Horns come from?
faq.answer: Hatefury satyrs in the Sargeron ruins east of Nijel’s Point carry the horns.
Kreldig Ungor collects ten Hatefury Horns for a reagent list sent by Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos.
Kreldig gathers the horns as reagents for Leftwitch in Kharanos.
Kreldig also asks for ten Hatefury Claws.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may know Leftwitch by reputation: the mage in Kharanos sent the Reclaimers a list of reagents.
